name: glycin
reason: Its documented local image Loader can use bundled image-rs for PNM, but no pinned local setup and passing P1/P2/P3 adapter were established.

name: glycin-image-rs
reason: Source maps PBM, PGM, and PPM MIME types to image-rs PnmDecoder, but a documented direct local-input adapter and passing control were not established.

name: opencv
reason: OpenCV imgcodecs may decode PNM, but the required native OpenCV installation was unavailable in this environment and no pinned Rust binding adapter passed.

name: zune-ppm
reason: Its published support table explicitly excludes ASCII P1, P2, and P3; it handles binary P5/P6/P7/PFM.

name: zune-image
reason: Its PNM route uses zune-ppm, whose P1/P2/P3 support is absent in this release.

name: zenpnm
reason: The published supported-format list starts at binary P5/P6/P7 and PFM, with no ASCII P1/P2/P3.

name: tinyppm
reason: Published loader accepts binary P6 PPM only.

name: aci_ppm
reason: Its PNM decoder dispatch accepts P6 only; the other decode API concerns Flipnote animation data.

name: micropnm
reason: Package description specifies binary PPM only.

name: rust-ppm
reason: Its documented PPM decoder is binary P6 only.

name: rustvision
reason: Its documentation says image input supports P6 only; the P3 API is output only.

name: pxm
reason: Published loader handles Portable FloatMap (PFM), not verified P1/P2/P3.

name: imageformat
reason: Format probing does not establish parsed PNM dimensions or samples.

name: file-format
reason: Its PNM classification identifies signatures and does not parse image dimensions or samples.

name: tina
reason: A generic platform umbrella re-exports an image crate but adds no documented PNM input API or independent PNM path; including it would pad with unrelated software.

name: oxiarc-image
reason: Its ImageFormat::Pnm enum is documented as not implemented, despite PNM magic recognition.

name: pnm-cli
reason: The registry hit is a personal Verifiable Trust Agent, unrelated to Portable Anymap.

name: rs-pnm-shrink
reason: Published package is a CLI tool without a documented reusable local PNM parsing library API for this collection.
